name: Candlemaker
ability: You start knowing how many evil players sit within 2 seats of you.
firstNightReminder: Show the number of evil players within 2 seats of the Candlemaker.

name: Lantern Bearer
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Minion.
firstNightReminder: The Lantern Bearer points to 2 players. Nod if either is a Minion.
otherNightReminder: The Lantern Bearer points to 2 players. Nod if either is a Minion.

name: Trick-or-Treater
ability: Each night*, knock on a player's door: you learn 'Trick' if they are the Demon, otherwise 'Treat'. If you knocked on the Demon, it may kill you tonight as well.
otherNightReminder: The Trick-or-Treater points to a player. Show TRICK if Demon, else TREAT. If Demon, the Demon may also kill them (resolve before dawn).

name: Gravekeeper
ability: Each night*, choose a player who died today or tonight: you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: If anyone died since the last dusk, the Gravekeeper chooses one. Show their character token.

name: Séance Medium
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: you learn their alignment & the character that killed them (if any).
otherNightReminder: If the Medium uses their ability, they point to a dead player. Show alignment, then the killing character (or shake head).

name: Crow Whisperer
ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose 2 players: you learn if they are on the same team.
otherNightReminder: If the Crow Whisperer died tonight, they point to 2 players. Nod if same team.

name: Night Watchman
ability: Each night*, you learn how many different players were chosen by evil abilities tonight.
otherNightReminder: Show the number of different players chosen by evil abilities tonight.

name: Bell Ringer
ability: The first time a good player dies at night, all players learn how many Minions are alive.

name: Priest
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Priest points to a player (not themselves). Mark them Blessed.

name: Salt Circle
ability: Once per game, at night*, draw the circle: you & your living neighbours cannot die tonight.
otherNightReminder: If the Salt Circle uses their ability, mark them and their living neighbours Protected.

name: Silversmith
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

name: Exhumer
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are good, they are resurrected with their ability. If evil, you die.
otherNightReminder: If the Exhumer uses their ability, they point to a dead player. Good: resurrect. Evil: the Exhumer dies.

name: Scarecrow
ability: The first time you would die at night, you don't, and you learn which character chose you.
otherNightReminder: If the Scarecrow was saved tonight, show them the character that chose them.

name: Black Cat
ability: Your living neighbours are unlucky: they might register as evil.

name: Restless Spirit
ability: If you are executed, the Demon kills an extra player tonight.

name: Possessed
ability: The Demon knows who you are. Once per game, at night, the Demon may make you evil (you learn this).
firstNightReminder: Show the Demon the Possessed player.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon chooses to turn the Possessed, wake the Possessed and show them the YOU ARE EVIL token.

name: Poisoned Apple
ability: If you die at night, both your living neighbours are poisoned until dusk tomorrow.

name: Hexer
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight & tomorrow day.
firstNightReminder: The Hexer points to a player. Mark them Hexed.
otherNightReminder: The Hexer points to a player. Mark them Hexed.

name: Changeling
ability: You might register as good & as a Townsfolk. Each night*, choose a player: if they are a Townsfolk, you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: The Changeling points to a player. If Townsfolk, show their character; otherwise shake head.

name: Grave Robber
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: you have their ability until dusk tomorrow.
otherNightReminder: The Grave Robber points to a dead player. They gain that ability until dusk tomorrow (wake them at that character's time if needed).

name: Masked Stranger
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: they die. Then you die.

name: Headless Horseman
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. On the night after an execution, choose 2 players instead.
otherNightReminder: The Horseman points to a player (2 if there was an execution today). They die.

name: Vampire Count
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, if you choose a Townsfolk, they become an evil Thrall instead (a Minion with no ability).
otherNightReminder: The Count points to a player. They die, or (once) if Townsfolk, wake them and show YOU ARE EVIL; they lose their ability.

name: Hollow King
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die at dusk tomorrow unless they nominate or are nominated that day.
otherNightReminder: The Hollow King points to a player. Mark them Carved. At dusk tomorrow they die unless they nominated or were nominated.

name: Lich
ability: On your 1st night, choose a Minion: your phylactery. Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you die while your phylactery lives, it dies instead & you live.
firstNightReminder: The Lich points to a Minion. Mark them Phylactery.
otherNightReminder: The Lich points to a player. They die.
